author: HCDE
text:
Hi AK,

I've already been through that questionning, below is my opinion on your questions:

1- The answer is no. There will be a signal UP after your B rectangle is
 broken (On the condition that price really stops into space after
engulfing B, i've to admit i haven't take time to analyze GU that far)

2- This is kind of the same question, and both these questions originate
 from the same mistake you make i guess. I'm sorry i've nothing to draw
and chart right now so i can't elaborate like i'd like to do but let's
just focus on the SR kink scenario for now. To me, the importance is
given by the barrier broken. If it's a low seen on MN like for GU, the
kink of it is of MN importance, whatever TF the kink is visible on. If
you have to go to M1 to understand where the extreme of the kink then go
 to M1, but your kink still is a MN SR kink, not a M1 kink.

You can Watch again RTM Lite part 2, there is a part of the video where
IF explains it under the term of 'hidden kink', I guess it could clear
that point up for you.

I suggest you clarify first that scale problem with that S/R kink
scenario before you work on LS kinks scales importance, because this is
much more disturbing with LS kinks than with SR kinks because many
things happen on LTF with them. That's probably why IF discovered first
SR kinks ("FLs" back in the days) and filled markpedia with it in
2012-2013, and came up with the LS kinks stuffs later

Looking forward to your next posts on that subject it's so interesting.

Good luck,

Hugo
